home.heroTitle: Analytical Alerts for XAU/USD inside Realtime Cockpit.
home.heroBody: Analytical software for the gold market, built around H1 Bias, DXY, liquidity sweep and M5 analysis. Everything is designed so an active Analytical Alert is never confused with alert history.
home.algoBody: Multi-layer data confluence reduces market noise and organizes technical context. The system presents only Analytical Alerts that pass environment, liquidity and M5 confirmation filters.
home.storyTitle: From script to Zeta Signals platform
story: Zeta Signals was created to bring structure to gold-market decisions. Instead of reacting to every candle, the system builds higher-timeframe context, filters noise and allows only setups that make sense inside market structure and high-liquidity windows.

steps.title: Layer 1: H1 Bias
steps.body: Every Analytical Alert starts with H1 trend analysis. The engine checks price position against EMA 200 and the Ichimoku Cloud. DXY analysis adds a safety filter that blocks risky setups. Analysis runs during liquidity windows: London (09:00-12:00) and New York (14:30-18:30).

steps.title: Layer 2: Liquidity Sweep
steps.body: The algorithm scans the last 24 hours of H1 structure for key highs and lows. A setup forms only after aggressive liquidity clearing and a quick return above or below the level within a maximum of 3 M5 candles.

steps.title: Layer 3: M5 Trigger
steps.body: The final Analytical Alert appears after momentum confirmation through a Fair Value Gap or Engulfing formation supported by an RSI reversal. Technical SL and TP levels are generated by the algorithm as analytical data, not instructions to trade.

faq.q: Why are there no Analytical Alerts every few minutes?
faq.a: The system generates an Analytical Alert only when H1 conditions, DXY correlation, liquidity window and M5 trigger align.

faq.q: Do I need an account with a specific broker?
faq.a: No. Analytical Alerts are based on XAU/USD data and can be read independently of the broker offering gold, with latency and spread differences in mind.
The algorithm analyzes the market mainly during London and New York sessions. Outside these blocks, the system switches into monitoring mode.

dashboard.title: Zeta Signals - XAU/USD dashboard
dashboard.body: Gold is a market of exceptional liquidity and above-average volatility. The panel shows price, market status and realtime Analytical Alerts without page reloads.
notes: Only one active Analytical Alert is available at a time, so stale entries never remain highlighted.
When technical TP, technical SL or a time limit resolves an alert, the backend sends a status update to every connected terminal.
The ticker, market badge and Analytical Alert history are designed to keep data readable and unambiguous.
